text: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we work. Many companies now use automation to handle repetitive tasks, which saves time and reduces mistakes. Productivity tools powered by AI, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, help employees focus on more important work. Instead of replacing people, AI often works alongside them. This human-AI collaboration allows workers to make better decisions and solve problems faster. However, jobs are changing. Some roles may disappear, while new ones are created. This means workers need to learn new skills to stay competitive. Overall, AI offers great opportunities, but it also requires us to adapt to a rapidly changing workplace.
